title: Multi-View Latent MoE: Letting Every Router Shape Expert Computation
abstract: arXiv:2610.40577v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models expand parameter capacity by activating a small subset of experts per token. Expert selection directly affects model capabilities under a fixed active-expert budget. Dense evaluation of all experts reveals weak agreement between single-router rankings and expert-utility evaluation rankings, especially in middle and deep layers. Richer signals for selection and computation incur additional cost: selection based on internal expert activations requires preliminary computation, while processing multiple full representations separately through the same expert repeats its computation. We propose Multi-View Latent MoE to improve expert selection with multiple routers and reuse their preferences to modulate expert computation under a fixed expert budget. Its Multi-Router submodule aggregates sigmoid scores from independently initialized routers. These routers develop highly differentiated expert prefere

translated_title: 多视角潜在混合专家：让每个路由器塑造专家计算
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.40577v2 公告类型： replace 摘要：稀疏混合专家模型通过为每个词元激活一小部分专家来扩展参数容量。在固定的活跃专家预算下，专家选择直接影响模型能力。对所有专家进行稠密评估发现，单路由器的排序与专家效用评估排序之间的一致性较弱，尤其是在中间层和深层。更丰富的选择与计算信号会带来额外成本：基于内部专家激活进行选择需要预先计算，而将多个完整表示分别通过同一专家处理则会重复计算。我们提出多视角潜在MoE，通过多个路由器改进专家选择，并在固定的专家预算下复用它们的偏好来调制专家计算。其多路由器子模块聚合来自独立初始化路由器的sigmoid分数。这些路由器发展出高度差异化的专家偏好……
tldr: 提出多视角潜在MoE框架，利用多个独立路由器聚合的信号改进专家选择，并复用路由器偏好来调制专家计算，从而在固定专家预算下提升模型能力。
en_tdlr: Multi-View Latent MoE improves expert selection with multiple independently initialized routers and reuses their preferences to modulate expert computation under a fixed expert budget.
